IncidentDef.label: space infestation
IncidentDef.letterText: A swarm of parasitic exo-matter, carried within dense rock, is hurling towards you. They will impact the area in a few seconds and plant exohives.\n\nIf you don’t want the insects to infest the whole area, prioritize destroying the hives. But beware - the exoinsectoids are aggressive and will defend their hives.

PawnsArrivalModeDef.textEnemy: A group of {0} from {1} have arrived in a tactical attack! A salvager dropship bombarded the landing zone with rocketswarm missile pods, deployed the strike team, and immediately departed.
PawnsArrivalModeDef.textWillArrive: A group of {0} from {1} will arrive shortly for a tactical attack. A salvager dropship will bombard the landing zone with rocketswarm missile pods, drop off the team, and then depart.
PawnsArrivalModeDef.textFriendly: A group of friendly {0} from {1} have arrived for a tactical assault! Their salvager dropship bombarded the landing zone with rocketswarm missile pods to clear the area, dropped off the team, and departed.
